item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 9:00 PM, 07 November 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Norzagaray and San Jose del Monte), Laguna (Pakil, Pangil, Siniloan, Famy, Santa Maria, Paete, Kalayaan, Lumban, Cavinti, Mabitac, Luisiana, and Majayjay), Quezon (Jomalig, Infanta, Real, Mauban, Alabat, Perez, Guinayangan, Calauag, Quezon, Sampaloc, and Lucban), and Rizal (Tanay, Rodriguez, Antipolo, Pililla, Jala-Jala, Baras, and San Mateo) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Quezon (General Nakar, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, and Tagkawayan) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
